ru: Видел ли ты того, кто считает ложью воздаяние
en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense
For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor
So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer
Those who make show [of their deeds]
tl: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen
Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen
tc: Ара-айтал лази ю каззибу бид дин
Ва ла я худду ’ала та’амил мискин
